sources.title: Rwandan passport holders — visa-free countries
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration, Rwanda
sources.officialityEvidence: Rwanda DGIE's live table separates ordinary, service and diplomatic passport columns, but has no publication or update date and conflicts with current destination evidence for several scoped rows.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Interior Ministry portal proves pre-travel PDF issuance but asks applicants to determine eligibility without publishing a Rwandan ordinary-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa service
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's current state e-government page proves electronic issuance but publishes no Rwandan ordinary-passport eligibility or exemption schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival service
sources.officialityEvidence: Liberia Immigration's live arrival service is conditional on embassy availability, so it does not validate Rwanda DGIE's undated visa-free label as a passport-only baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

unresolved.reason: No current Afghan or Rwandan authority source establishes an ordinary Rwandan-passport short-visitor route and actual issuance timing; operational restrictions are not a status.

Rwanda DGIE's undated table says visa upon arrival, but Cabo Verde's current Government schedules do not establish an ordinary Rwandan-passport arrival route. EASE registration is not visa eligibility.
Current Comorian law describes visas but no current competent authority publishes an ordinary Rwandan-passport exemption, electronic, advance or arrival-issued visitor rule.
Rwanda DGIE's undated table says visa not required, but Grenada's available nationality schedule is expressly from February 2021 and lacks current-force corroboration.
Iran's current MFA portal has generic application and named exception material but no current ordinary Rwandan-passport route. A portal and omissions do not establish eligibility or issuance timing.
Iraq's current federal sources and eVisa portal do not produce a positive ordinary Rwandan-passport visitor decision. Kurdistan Region material is not used for a federal baseline.
Rwanda DGIE's undated table says visa not required, while Jordan's current tourism guidance describes a paid arrival visa but does not map Rwanda into a waiver or exception mechanism.
Kuwait Interior data exposes visitor products but no positive controlling ordinary Rwandan tourist-nationality decision. GCC-resident, sponsor and third-country-document routes are excluded.
Kyrgyzstan's eVisa selector requires a positive country and document result, which was not recoverable for this ordinary passport. Generic eVisa availability is not eligibility evidence.
No retrievable current Libyan or Rwandan government source establishes an ordinary Rwandan-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing.
Myanmar's current tourist eVisa and waiver cohorts do not name this ordinary passport. Omission and generic online application are not a nationality-specific complement.
No current DPRK or Rwandan primary source establishes an ordinary Rwandan-passport visitor route. Operational access restrictions cannot be normalized to a visa status.
North Macedonia's live country checker did not yield a reproducible Rwandan ordinary-passport decision, and no current operative nationality regulation was recovered.
Current Omani ROP eligibility sessions do not establish an unconditional individual tourist product for this nationality; family, property and special-purpose paths are excluded.
Israeli crossing and permit controls do not establish a Palestine-wide ordinary Rwandan-passport visitor baseline, and no Palestinian authority publishes one.
No current Panamanian or Rwandan official nationality schedule establishes an ordinary Rwandan-passport visitor baseline. Conditional third-country-document routes are excluded.

Saudi Arabia's live eligibility data marks the nationality ineligible for the unconditional tourist route; available residence or third-country-document paths are conditional. No advance-visa complement is inferred.
Rwanda DGIE says visa upon arrival, but Sierra Leone's live official material conflicts between emailed eVisa issuance and airport-issued descriptions. One Rwandan route cannot be normalized.
Current Solomon Islands Immigration material conflicts between electronic processing and manual in-person applications, while arrival issuance is discretionary and not nationality-mapped.
Sudan Passport Directorate material describes visitor categories and counter processing but supplies no ordinary Rwandan-passport eligibility or prior-approval schedule.
Syria's current aviation material requires an advance visa unless exempt but gives no ordinary-passport nationality schedule; its online service does not establish electronic issuance.
Trinidad and Tobago's current waiver material does not give a positive Rwandan ordinary-passport result, and no visa-required complement is inferred from omission or portal availability.
Tunisia's current consular material establishes a visa process and treaty-qualified waivers but no current ordinary Rwandan-passport schedule or effective agreement register.
Turkmenistan's general entry-visa rule preserves treaty exceptions but no current ordinary Rwandan-passport exemption or unconditional issuance route is published. Invitation routes are excluded.

Rwanda DGIE says visa not required, but Vanuatu's live nationality material places Rwanda in inconsistent cohorts. Its tourist rules distinguish arrival issuance from advance approval, so the conflict cannot be normalized.
